nodes.name: fetch-assets.mjs
nodes.summary: Downloads public reference assets into the local project; not executed during analysis because it accesses the network.

nodes.name: inspect-reference.mjs
nodes.summary: Uses browser automation to inspect the public reference and save visual/DOM observations; not run here.

nodes.name: qa-check.mjs
nodes.summary: Contains local browser QA assertions for the reconstruction; source was analyzed without launching a browser.

nodes.name: verify-local.mjs
nodes.summary: Checks local rendered structure, keyboard behavior, responsive views and media using browser automation.

nodes.name: fonts.css
nodes.summary: Declares locally served Manrope and Libre Caslon Display font faces and weights.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents where licensed replacement media belongs and how browser URLs map to the public directory.

nodes.name: capture.cjs
nodes.summary: Captures local preview screenshots using the sibling Playwright installation.

nodes.name: server-check.mjs
nodes.summary: Creates synthetic loopback servers to verify a busy unrelated port is preserved and preview moves to the next port.

nodes.name: server.mjs
nodes.summary: Serves the existing dist build on loopback port 5175 by default, builds only if missing, checks its preview marker and retries occupied ports.

nodes.name: verify.cjs
nodes.summary: Exercises seven room selectors, anchors, photo dialog keyboard/focus behavior, contacts, responsive layouts and offline interactions.

nodes.name: revamp.css
nodes.summary: Overrides the base styles for the named room selectors, direct index, clearer chapters and full-size photo dialog.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Defines the base palette, typography, photographic page sections, responsive layouts, focus states and reduced-motion behavior.
